info.title: Calendly - Tipos de Evento e Disponibilidade

tags.name: Event Types
tags.description: Endpoints for listing, retrieving, and managing event types that define the kinds of meetings users can schedule.

tags.name: Availability
tags.description: Endpoints for viewing available times for event types and managing user availability schedules.

tags.name: Shares
tags.description: Endpoints for creating and managing shareable scheduling links.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of event types for the specified user or organization. Event types define the kinds of meetings that can be scheduled, including their duration, location, and availability.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The URI of the user whose event types to list. Required if organization is not specified.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The URI of the organization whose event types to list. Required if user is not specified.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active status. When true, only active event types are returned.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for results. Use name:asc or name:desc.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: A token for fetching the next page of results from a previous paginated response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of event types

items.description: An event type defines a kind of meeting that can be scheduled, including its duration, location, and availability configuration.

uri.description: The canonical URI of the event type resource.

name.description: The name of the event type.

active.description: Whether the event type is currently active and available for scheduling.

booking_method.description: The booking method for the event type.

slug.description: The URL-friendly slug for the event type.

scheduling_url.description: The URL of the event types scheduling page.

duration.description: The default duration of the event in minutes.

kind.description: Whether the event type is for solo or group meetings.

pooling_type.description: For team event types, the pooling strategy for host assignment.

type.description: The type classification of the event type.

color.description: The hex color code associated with the event type.

description_plain.description: The plain text description of the event type.

description_html.description: The HTML-formatted description of the event type.

internal_note.description: An internal note visible only to the event host.

profile.description: The profile associated with the event type.

owner.description: The URI of the profile owner.

secret.description: Whether the event type is hidden from the scheduling page.

deleted_at.description: The timestamp when the event type was deleted, if applicable.

items.description: A custom question displayed on the event type booking page.

uuid.description: The UUID of the custom question.

type.description: The type of input expected for the answer.

position.description: The display order of the question.

enabled.description: Whether the question is currently enabled.

answer_choices.description: The available answer choices for select-type questions.

include_other.description: Whether an Other option is included in select-type questions.

custom_questions.description: Custom questions displayed on the booking page.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the event type was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the event type was last updated.

pagination.description: Pagination information for paginated list responses.

count.description: The number of results in the current page.

next_page.description: The URL of the next page of results, if available.

previous_page.description: The URL of the previous page of results, if available.

next_page_token.description: The token to fetch the next page of results.

previous_page_token.description: The token to fetch the previous page of results.

get.description: Returns a list of available time slots for a specific event type within a given date range. This endpoint is used to display bookable times to potential invitees.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: The URI of the event type to check availability for.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The start of the time range to check, in UTC format.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The end of the time range to check, in UTC format.

items.description: An available time slot for an event type that can be booked by an invitee.

status.description: The status of the time slot.

invitees_remaining.description: The number of remaining spots for group events.

start_time.description: The start time of the available slot in UTC.

scheduling_url.description: The URL to schedule at this specific time.

end_time.description: The end of the busy period in UTC.

buffered_start_time.description: The start time including buffer periods.

buffered_end_time.description: The end time including buffer periods.

get.description: Returns a list of availability schedules for a specific user. Availability schedules define the recurring time windows when a user is available for meetings.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The URI of the user whose availability schedules to retrieve.

items.description: An availability schedule defining recurring time windows when a user is available for meetings.

uri.description: The canonical URI of the availability schedule resource.

name.description: The name of the availability schedule.

default.description: Whether this is the users default availability schedule.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone for the schedule.

type.description: The type of rule (recurring weekday or specific date).

wday.description: The day of the week for wday-type rules.

date.description: The specific date for date-type rules.

from.description: The start time of the interval (HH:MM format).

to.description: The end time of the interval (HH:MM format).

intervals.description: The time intervals during which the user is available.

rules.description: The availability rules defining when the user is available.
